brief.question: Do complete L=2 angular weak potential/lapse and separate radial-flux slots pass normalization, regularity, reconstruction, realification and refinement checks at six fixed (m,r) cases?
brief.healthy: Setup one environment, three control batches, six angular snapshots, one final export. Success is angular_export_passed after the complete JSON write. Raw substages are timings only. All independent complex slot entries are computed; no Hermitian mirroring fills missing entries.
brief.noise: This is a new workload with unmeasured runtime. Fixed-radius snapshots are not a radial coefficient-function export. Scope exclusions for radial projection, domain choice, finite K/E/D, ranks, spectra, seeds and nonlinear claims are intentional. The 24/48 refinement is informative; the fixed acceptance comparison is 48/96 at 2e-10 scaled error.
brief.worth_a_flag: Any nonfinite value, unsupported integrand, denominator root on [-1,1], normalization/reconstruction/sign/Hermiticity failure, failed 48/96 refinement, incomplete final JSON, resource stop or unresolved cleanup. A computational stop is not a physical no-go.
brief.from_parent: The parent completed its eight-batch local weak/Green validation. This child reuses unchanged physics modules but adds complete angular integration at two radii and independent assembly controls. The parent did not perform this angular diagnostic.
brief.decided: Preparation only. Proposed one local process, 300-second wall cap and sampled 2-GiB RSS threshold. Per-run approval is required and not yet recorded. The inherited overnight cutoff is an additional limit, not approval. No remote or GPU compute.
